summary: Rolled back auth-api, billing-api, catalog-svc, edge-gateway, pricing-svc, search-api and session-svc to healthy releases in prod. notify-worker was left alone (only earlier release is pre-2026-09-10) and orders-api is still degraded because its rollback returned 403 Forbidden. Also, auth-api was rolled back twice because a 504 on the first call had actually succeeded and status was stale, so its live build (b-35, commit 4efbe996) was originally created 2026-09-09, before the cutoff; it is healthy but this violates the constraint and needs human review.
